About Us
pave the way for groundbreaking ventures across various industries.
Our Heritage
Nanolite Group of Companies was founded in 2010 by the visionary entrepreneur Muhammad Momen, who recognized the need
for innovative and sustainable solutions in the construction industry. Since our inception, we have consistently pushed the boundaries of technology and creativity, leading to our emergence as a pioneer in the lightweight construction materials sector.
Our Vision
At Nanolite Group, our vision is to be the leading provider of innovative, sustainable, and high-quality products across multiple
industries. We aim to revolutionize construction practices with our CLC blocks while making significant strides in textiles, technology, mining, and agriculture. Our commitment to research and development ensures that we stay ahead of market
trends and continuously improve our offerings.
Our Mission
Our mission is to deliver exceptional value to our customers through innovative products, unparalleled service, and sustainable practices. We strive to foster strong relationships with our stakeholders while creating a positive impact on the communities we serve. By embracing cutting-edge technology and sustainable practices, we aim to enhance the quality of
life for our customers and contribute to a healthier planet.
Message from Our CEO & Founder, Muhammad Momen
"As the founder of Nanolite Group, I am proud to lead a company that embodies innovation, sustainability, and integrity. From our beginnings as a small startup specializing in Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC), we have grown into a diversified conglomerate that is committed to making a positive impact on the industries we serve. Our team’s dedication to research and development has enabled us to create superior products that not only meet the demands of our customers but also adhere to the highest standards of sustainability.
At Nanolite, we believe in the power of collaboration, continuous learning, and embracing new technologies. Our commitment to excellence drives us to explore new horizons, and I am excited about the future of our company and the opportunities that lie ahead."
Message from Our Chairman, Malik Mehmood
"Nanolite Group stands as a testament to what can be achieved through hard work, determination, and visionary leadership. Under the guidance of Muhammad Momen, we have transformed from a small enterprise into a leader in the lightweight construction sector and beyond. Our diverse portfolio reflects our commitment to innovation and adaptability, ensuring that we remain at the forefront of industry advancements.
As Chairman, I am committed to upholding the values that define our organization —integrity, quality, and customer satisfaction. I believe in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration, empowering our team to innovate and excel in their respective fields. Together, we will continue to shape the future of our industries while contributing to sustainable development globally."
Commitment to Community
Nanolite Group is dedicated to giving back to the community. We actively engage in various corporate social responsibility initiatives aimed at promoting education, sustainability, and social welfare. Through partnerships with
local organizations and educational institutions, we aim to make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.
Our Flagship Product: The Journey of CLC
At the heart of Nanolite’s success is our flagship product, Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC) Blocks, the culmination of over 9 years of dedicated research and development. With over 200 unique formulas, our CLC blocks represent an unparalleled innovation in lightweight construction materials.

12 roles
Automation & Control Engineer — CLC Production Plants
Plant engineering
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Develop and commission controls for batching, mixing, pumping and foaming equipment.
Responsibilities
Program PLC sequences, interlocks, alarms and HMI screens for automated CLC production.
Integrate load cells, level sensors, flow meters, motors and variable-frequency drives.
Prepare I/O lists, control-panel drawings, test procedures and operator instructions.
Troubleshoot plant faults and support commissioning alongside fabrication and production teams.
Qualifications
Electrical, electronics or mechatronics degree; a relevant technical diploma with strong commissioning experience is also suitable.
Experience
3+ years in industrial automation; hands-on PLC commissioning is essential.
Practical skills
PLC logic and HMI development
Motor control, instrumentation and electrical schematic reading
Safe isolation, fault finding and commissioning documentation
Software & equipment
Siemens TIA Portal / WinCC or equivalent PLC/HMI platform
AutoCAD Electrical or EPLAN
VFD configuration and industrial communications such as Modbus
Register interest
Mechanical Design Engineer — Mixing & Batching Equipment
Plant engineering
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Design manufacturable mixers, frames, tanks, conveyors and plant assemblies.
Responsibilities
Create fabrication drawings, assemblies and bills of materials.
Select motors, gearboxes, bearings and drive components for mixing equipment.
Check clearances, maintenance access, weld details and fabrication tolerances.
Work with the workshop to resolve fit-up issues and update drawings after trials.
Qualifications
Mechanical engineering degree or mechanical design diploma with an equipment-design portfolio.
Experience
3+ years designing fabricated industrial machinery.
Practical skills
3D assemblies and production drawings
Steel fabrication, shaft and bearing selection
BOM preparation and design revision control
Software & equipment
SolidWorks or Autodesk Inventor
AutoCAD
Excel for calculations and BOMs
Register interest
MIG / MAG Welder — Plant Frames & Assemblies
Workshop & fabrication
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Fabricate welded steel structures and assemblies for Nanolite production equipment.
Responsibilities
Read fabrication drawings and prepare steel joints.
Set welding parameters and produce consistent MIG/MAG welds.
Control distortion, inspect finished welds and correct defects.
Maintain welding equipment and follow workshop PPE and hot-work procedures.
Qualifications
Welding trade certificate preferred; practical experience and a successful welding test can substitute. A high-school diploma is not mandatory.
Experience
2+ years welding steel frames, machinery or industrial assemblies.
Practical skills
Drawing reading and dimensional checks
Joint preparation and weld defect recognition
Safe handling of grinders, gas cylinders and welding equipment
Software & equipment
MIG/MAG welding sets
Grinders, clamps and measuring tools
Workshop drawings and weld procedures
Register interest
TIG Welder — Stainless Tanks & Pipework
Workshop & fabrication
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Produce clean stainless-steel tank, pipe and fitting welds for process equipment.
Responsibilities
Prepare and fit stainless components without contamination.
Perform TIG welds with appropriate shielding and purging.
Check joints for finish, alignment and leaks.
Record completed work and coordinate repairs with quality inspection.
Qualifications
TIG welding trade training preferred; demonstrated skill in a practical test is acceptable without a formal diploma.
Experience
2+ years TIG welding stainless sheet, tanks or pipework.
Practical skills
Thin-wall stainless welding
Back purging and heat control
Fit-up accuracy and leak-check preparation
Software & equipment
TIG welding sets
Purging and gas-flow equipment
Pipe clamps and inspection gauges
Register interest
Fabrication Fitter — CLC Plant Assembly
Workshop & fabrication
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Fit and assemble mechanical equipment from production drawings.
Responsibilities
Mark, cut, drill and fit structural steel and fabricated parts.
Align shafts, motors, gearboxes and bearings.
Assemble guards, platforms, tanks and bolted plant sections.
Check dimensions and report drawing or component mismatches.
Qualifications
Mechanical fitting trade certificate or equivalent workshop experience. Formal schooling is not essential if practical skills are demonstrated.
Experience
2+ years fitting fabricated machinery or industrial structures.
Practical skills
Mechanical drawing reading
Alignment, leveling and precision measurement
Safe lifting and assembly practices
Software & equipment
Drill press, grinders and hand tools
Vernier calipers, levels and alignment tools
Mechanical assembly drawings
Register interest
Electromechanical Maintenance Technician — Production Equipment
Plant engineering
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Keep mixers, pumps, drives and production machinery reliable.
Responsibilities
Perform planned maintenance and diagnose mechanical or electrical faults.
Inspect bearings, belts, couplings, motors and control components.
Maintain breakdown records and recommend critical spare parts.
Isolate machinery safely and verify operation after repairs.
Qualifications
Electrical or mechanical technical diploma, trade certificate or equivalent industrial maintenance experience.
Experience
3+ years maintaining factory machinery; motor-control fault finding preferred.
Practical skills
Mechanical repair and basic electrical diagnostics
Preventive maintenance planning
Lockout procedures and maintenance records
Software & equipment
Multimeter and insulation tester
Mechanical maintenance tools
Excel or a maintenance management system

Production Supervisor — CLC Mixing & Block Manufacturing
Factory operations
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Coordinate daily CLC batches, moulding, curing and production quality.
Responsibilities
Plan shift work around batching, mould availability and curing requirements.
Check mix records, batch consistency and finished block dimensions.
Train operators and coordinate material supply and equipment readiness.
Record output, rejects and downtime; escalate safety and quality issues.
Qualifications
Production or mechanical technical diploma preferred; proven CLC or concrete production supervision may substitute.
Experience
3+ years in concrete or process manufacturing, including shift supervision.
Practical skills
Batch record control and material coordination

Production reporting and safe operating procedures

Excel

Project delivery & procurement
+

Deliver CLC equipment projects from approved drawings through build, testing and handover.
Responsibilities
Build project schedules, budgets and material delivery plans.
Coordinate design, procurement, fabrication and factory acceptance testing.
Track technical changes, risks and supplier delays.
Arrange commissioning and prepare handover documents and operator training.

Mechanical, electrical or industrial engineering qualification, or equivalent machinery-project delivery experience.
Experience
4+ years delivering industrial machinery or plant projects.
Practical skills

Technical coordination and change control
Supplier follow-up and commissioning planning

Excel
CAD drawing review and document-control tools

Procurement Specialist — Industrial Components & Steel
Project delivery & procurement
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Source the components and materials required to fabricate and maintain CLC production equipment.
Responsibilities
Purchase steel, motors, gearboxes, pumps, bearings and control components to approved specifications.
Compare technical quotations, lead times and total delivered costs.
Track purchase orders and coordinate incoming inspections.
Maintain supplier records and resolve missing, incorrect or delayed items.
Qualifications
Relevant diploma or degree preferred; proven technical purchasing experience is acceptable.
Experience
3+ years buying industrial materials, machinery components or electrical controls.
Practical skills
BOM and specification interpretation
Supplier negotiation and delivery follow-up
Purchase documentation and inventory awareness
Software & equipment
Excel
ERP or procurement software
Engineering BOMs and supplier catalogues
Register interest
Quality Inspector — Fabrication & Plant Assembly
Workshop & fabrication
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Verify fabricated parts and assembled plant equipment before dispatch.
Responsibilities
Check dimensions, fit-up, weld finish and assembly against drawings.
Document inspection results and identify non-conforming parts.
Witness functional checks and support factory acceptance testing.
Verify corrective work and maintain traceable inspection records.
Qualifications
Mechanical or manufacturing diploma preferred; experienced fabrication inspectors may qualify without a degree. Welding inspection training is an advantage.
Experience
2+ years inspecting steel fabrication or machinery assemblies.
Practical skills
Dimensional inspection and drawing interpretation
Basic weld defect recognition
Inspection records and corrective-action follow-up
Software & equipment
Vernier calipers, micrometers and weld gauges
Excel
Inspection checklists and fabrication drawings
Register interest
Production & Workshop Helper — Entry Level
Factory operations
+
Role profile for manufacturing recruitment. Location and vacancy availability are confirmed by the team.
Support trained operators and fabricators with materials preparation and workshop housekeeping.
Responsibilities
Prepare and move materials using approved handling methods.
Assist with mould cleaning, packing and supervised production tasks.
Keep work areas and tools organised.
Follow PPE instructions and report hazards or damaged equipment.
Qualifications
No degree or high-school diploma required. Basic reading and counting are helpful; task and safety training will be provided.
Experience
No previous experience required; reliable attendance and willingness to learn are essential.
Practical skills
Ability to follow instructions and work with a team
Careful material handling
Willingness to complete practical safety training
Software & equipment
Basic hand tools under supervision
Material checklists
PPE and approved handling equipment

About careers at NGC
Careers
Join us in shaping the future with cutting-edge technology, sustainable solutions, and a commitment to excellence.
We are always looking for talented and driven professionals to join our expanding team. Some of the areas where we regularly seek
Careers at Nanolite Group of Companies (NGC)
At Nanolite Group of Companies (NGC), we are more than just a company – we are a family of innovators, creators, and industry leaders. Our diverse ventures span construction, mining, technology, textiles, agriculture, and legal consultancy, offering exciting opportunities for professionals looking to make an impact in their respective fields.
Why Work with NGC?
Working at NGC means being part of a global team that thrives on innovation and growth. We are constantly seeking passionate individuals who want to grow with us and contribute to groundbreaking projects across multiple industries. At NGC, you will have the opportunity to work on pioneering solutions that make a real difference in the world, from lightweight construction materials to mining and technology innovations.
Opportunities for Growth & Development
At NGC, we’re not just offering jobs – we’re building careers. We invest in our employees' growth and provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development. Through our internal training programs, mentorship opportunities, and cross- department collaboration, you will have the resources to take your career to new heights. Our goal is to nurture leaders and innovators who will contribute to the long-term success of our company.
NGC’s diverse portfolio of businesses provides a unique environment where you can explore a variety of career paths and
roles. With a presence in multiple industries, our group is constantly expanding, offering exciting roles in various sectors:
Construction & Engineering: Work with Nanolite to develop sustainable, innovative construction materials like lightweight concrete that redefine building efficiency.
Mining & Export: Join NanoMines to help us ethically and sustainably extract precious minerals and deliver them to global markets.
Software & IT: Contribute to the digital world with NanoTech, our software house, offering custom software solutions to businesses worldwide.
Textile Export: At NanoLooms, assist in producing and exporting premium, eco-friendly textiles that meet international standards.
Agriculture & Farming: Help NanoFarms drive sustainable agriculture through the cultivation and export of fresh produce to international markets.
Legal Consultancy: Join NanoLaw, our legal consultancy firm, where we offer expert legal services across industries with a focus on accident cases and corporate legal advice.

  • Check dimensions, fit-up, weld finish and assembly against drawings.
  • Document inspection results and identify non-conforming parts.
  • Witness functional checks and support factory acceptance testing.
  • Verify corrective work and maintain traceable inspection records.

Qualifications

Mechanical or manufacturing diploma preferred; experienced fabrication inspectors may qualify without a degree. Welding inspection training is an advantage.

Experience

2+ years inspecting steel fabrication or machinery assemblies.

Practical skills

  • Dimensional inspection and drawing interpretation
  • Basic weld defect recognition
  • Inspection records and corrective-action follow-up

Software & equipment

  • Vernier calipers, micrometers and weld gauges
  • Excel
  • Inspection checklists and fabrication drawings

About careers at NGC

Careers

Join us in shaping the future with cutting-edge technology, sustainable solutions, and a commitment to excellence.

We are always looking for talented and driven professionals to join our expanding team. Some of the areas where we regularly seek

Careers at Nanolite Group of Companies (NGC)

At Nanolite Group of Companies (NGC), we are more than just a company – we are a family of innovators, creators, and industry leaders. Our diverse ventures span construction, mining, technology, textiles, agriculture, and legal consultancy, offering exciting opportunities for professionals looking to make an impact in their respective fields.

Why Work with NGC?

Working at NGC means being part of a global team that thrives on innovation and growth. We are constantly seeking passionate individuals who want to grow with us and contribute to groundbreaking projects across multiple industries. At NGC, you will have the opportunity to work on pioneering solutions that make a real difference in the world, from lightweight construction materials to mining and technology innovations.

Opportunities for Growth & Development

At NGC, we’re not just offering jobs – we’re building careers. We invest in our employees' growth and provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development. Through our internal training programs, mentorship opportunities, and cross- department collaboration, you will have the resources to take your career to new heights. Our goal is to nurture leaders and innovators who will contribute to the long-term success of our company.

NGC’s diverse portfolio of businesses provides a unique environment where you can explore a variety of career paths and roles. With a presence in multiple industries, our group is constantly expanding, offering exciting roles in various sectors: Construction & Engineering: Work with Nanolite to develop sustainable, innovative construction materials like lightweight concrete that redefine building efficiency.

Mining & Export: Join NanoMines to help us ethically and sustainably extract precious minerals and deliver them to global markets.

Software & IT: Contribute to the digital world with NanoTech, our software house, offering custom software solutions to businesses worldwide.

Textile Export: At NanoLooms, assist in producing and exporting premium, eco-friendly textiles that meet international standards.

Agriculture & Farming: Help NanoFarms drive sustainable agriculture through the cultivation and export of fresh produce to international markets.

Legal Consultancy: Join NanoLaw, our legal consultancy firm, where we offer expert legal services across industries with a focus on accident cases and corporate legal advice.
